Name: EnhancedRelationships
Author: Mizzion
Description:
Do you find making friends in Stardew Valley way too easy? Maybe You dislike the fact that you can miss the NPC's birthdays and there is nothing that happens. Well this mod changes that.



[size=4]What's in the mod:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]You will lose friendship each day unless you give the NPC a gift during the week.
[*]You will lose less friendship points the higher your heart level with the NPC is.
[*]If you happen to miss the NPC's birthday, they won't be pleased and will let you know when you talk to them.
[*]The NPC will say random things if you miss their Birthday. Currently there are Eight different Dialogues.
[/list]

[size=4]Friendship Calculation:

[/size][b]Friendship Decay [/b]= BasicAmount * HeartMultiplier
[b]Birthday Friendship Decay[/b][i] = (BasicAmount * HeartMultiplier ) + (BasicAmount * BirthdayMuliplier * BirthdayHeartMultiplier)[/i]


[size=4]Config File Settings:

[/size][b]AmtOfGiftsToKeepNpcHappy (INT)[/b] = This is the number of gifts you need to give to the NPC to keep them happy for the whole week and stop the friendship decay.
[b]BasicAmount (INT)[/b] = This is used in the Calculation of Friendship decay. See above for the calculation.
[b]EnableMissedBirthdays (BOOL)[/b] = Tells the mod if you want the NPC's to tell you when you have missed their birthday.
[b]EnableRounded (BOOL) [/b]= Tells the mod if the friendship decay should be rounded up to the nearest whole number.
[b]HeartMultiplier (FLOAT)[/b] = This is used in the Calculation of Friendship decay. See above for the calculation.
[b]BirthdayHeartMultiplier (FLOAT)[/b] = This is used in the Calculation of Friendship decay. See above for the calculation.
[b]BirthdayMultiplier (FLOAT)[/b] = This is used in the Calculation of Friendship decay. See above for the calculation.



[size=4]How to Install the Mod:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI (Currently 2.5.2): https://smapi.io
[*]Unzip the EnhancedRelationships folder from the ZIP file you downloaded here.
[*]Put the EnhancedRelationships folder inside your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[*]Run the game. It should be working now.
[/list]
